rules.why: every vanilla tank_heavy def carries openforcrush on a crew place; the GoH port has it switched off (its crew macros hold ';{openForCrush}' as a comment), so no seat is open for crush. '{openforcrush 0}' reads as false, which is the seat default, so the key is added with no change to crush behaviour
